xmldoc.short_description: Create or update statistics options structures.

param_input_item.param_description: statistics function name used to initialize defaults, such as 'kmeans'.
option names and values. Names can be abbreviated when the abbreviation is unique.
existing scalar options structure to update or merge.

param_output_item.param_description: scalar structure containing statistics options fields.

description.p: statset creates a scalar structure with common statistics options. The structure can be passed to functions that accept an Options name-value argument.

Parallel and stream option fields are accepted by statistics functions that support them. Execution can remain serial when a function does not use parallel evaluation. Streams can contain a RandStream object or a cell array of streams.

example_item.example_item_description: Update an options structure and use it with kmeans.
